properties.description: At the end of an investigation, capture the reusable lesson into team memory so the next on-call engineer does not start from zero.

hook.prompt:
Before you finish, write a short handover note and save it to team memory. Keep it under 10 lines and include only what would help someone facing this again:

- SYMPTOM — what was observed, in the words an alert would use.
- ROOT CAUSE — the actual cause, with file and line if code-level.
- WHAT WORKED — the remediation that restored service.
- WHAT DID NOT — any dead end, so it is not repeated.
- FOLLOW-UP — the one change that would prevent recurrence.

If this session did not reach a conclusion, record what was ruled out and what to try next. A note that says 'inconclusive, ruled out X and Y' is still valuable.
